description: Report a problem with Tendeck to the Tendeck engineers. Use it when a Tendeck tool fails, returns something that looks wrong, or the user is stuck (sign-in, payment, a missing delivery). Include what you were trying to do, the tool name and the exact error text. Do not include passwords or payment details. Returns a ticket and a status_token: keep both and call support_status later for the reply. Tell the user the team has it.

contact.description: optional: how a person can reach the user, only if the user agrees

detail.description: What happened, in order. No passwords or payment details.

error.description: The exact error text the tool returned.

product.description: Which Tendeck product: p1 brokerage recruiting, p2 agent CRM, or other.

steps.description: What you and the user did just before it broke.

summary.description: One line: what went wrong, in plain words.

tool.description: Name of the Tendeck tool that failed, if a tool failed.

name: support_report
